blocks.html: Where ambulatory care facilities require smoke compartmentation in accordance with Section 422.3 of this code, the fire protection and emergency preparedness plans shall comply with the applicable provisions of the New York City Fire Code and shall be in accordance with Section 1001.4 of this code.
